subject: Future Tech
title: Nature's Nanotechnology
description: A quick win: understand Nature's Nanotechnology.

hook.text: A gecko walks up a glass wall using millions of nanoscale hairs on its feet.

buildup.text: Lotus leaves repel water with nanoscale bumps.

twist.text: Biology proves nanotech works at scale.

climax.text: Biomimicry—copying nature's nanotricks—inspires self-cleaning coatings, adhesives, and structural colors.

punchline.text: Evolution perfected nanotech. We're just learning to copy it.

quiz.question: How do gecko feet stick to surfaces?
options: Millions of nanoscale hairs create molecular attraction
Tiny suction cups on each toe
